name: copy_bytes_as
title: Copy Bytes As
description: Formats a region of the currently selected data source as a language array literal (C, C++, Java, C#, Rust, Python, JavaScript, Lua, Go, Crystal, Swift, Pascal, base64, hex view, or HTML). Uses ImHex's existing DataFormatter registry so the output matches what the GUI's 'Copy As' menu produces. Pure read.

format.description: Output format. Short name ('c', 'cpp', 'rust', 'python', 'java', 'csharp', 'go', 'lua', 'js', 'swift', 'pascal', 'crystal', 'base64', 'hex_view', 'html') or the full unlocalized name.

size.description: Number of bytes to copy. Defaults to the rest of the data source

output.description: The formatted output, ready to paste into code
